evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and modifies core logging behavior in src/logging.cpp and string utilities in src/util/string.h.
rationale: Prevents log injection vulnerabilities where untrusted inputs like RPC method names can forge arbitrary lines in debug.log. As shown in the description, callers could forge critical error lines such as 'ERROR: ConnectTip: ConnectBlock ... failed' to mislead operators or monitoring tools.
